issues.description: When page-sized cursor progress crosses a page-table-node boundary, move_forward does not ascend to the parent and pop_level would leave the departed child guard in a slot that must be empty at the higher level.
issues.rationale: At the last entry of a level-L node, next_va wraps pte_index(next_va,L) to zero and belongs under the next parent entry, but the disabled upward loop retains level L and the old child guard while changing va. The address and retained path can then describe different subtrees. The dormant pop_level cannot independently complete the transition because it increments level without clearing the departed level-L slot, while path_wf requires every slot below the new current level to be None. Repair 1b93c8f atomically activates the index-wrap loop and clears each departed slot before increasing level. Enabling only the loop or repairing only the unreachable helper is insufficient, so these edits form one level-transition root.
